content: I want an angular plate with two quadratic plates positioned in right angel to each other. The edge length of the plates is 140mm. They are 10mm thick. On one of the two plates I would like to have a quadratic cutout, 45x45mm, centred on the plate. | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once

function_call.arguments: "{\"PythonCode\":\"# Calculate the positions and dimensions for the two quadratic plates\\nedge_length = 140  # mm\\nthickness = 10  # mm\\n\\n# First plate (along x-y plane)\\nx_size_1 = edge_length\\ny_size_1 = edge_length\\nz_size_1 = thickness\\nx_1 = 0\\ny_1 = 0\\nz_1 = 0\\n\\n# Second plate (along y-z plane, rotated 90 degrees around the y-axis)\\nx_size_2 = thickness\\ny_size_2 = edge_length\\nz_size_2 = edge_length\\nx_2 = edge_length - thickness  # Positioned adjacent to the first plate\\ny_2 = 0\\nz_2 = 0\\n\\n# Cutout dimensions and position on the first plate\\ncutout_size = 45  # mm\\ncutout_x = (edge_length - cutout_size) / 2  # Centered along x\\ny_cutout = (edge_length - cutout_size) / 2  # Centered along y\\nz_cutout = 0  # On the surface of the first plate\\n\\n# Return the calculated values\\n{\\n    \\\"x_size_1\\\": x_size_1, \\\"y_size_1\\\": y_size_1, \\\"z_size_1\\\": z_size_1, \\\"x_1\\\": x_1, \\\"y_1\\\": y_1, \\\"z_1\\\": z_1,\\n    \\\"x_size_2\\\": x_size_2, \\\"y_size_2\\\": y_size_2, \\\"z_size_2\\\": z_size_2, \\\"x_2\\\": x_2, \\\"y_2\\\": y_2, \\\"z_2\\\": z_2,\\n    \\\"cutout_size\\\": cutout_size, \\\"cutout_x\\\": cutout_x, \\\"y_cutout\\\": y_cutout, \\\"z_cutout\\\": z_cutout\\n}\"}"

{"PythonCode":"# Calculate the positions and dimensions for the two quadratic plates
edge_length = 140  # mm
thickness = 10  # mm

# First plate (along x-y plane)

y_size_1 = edge_length
z_size_1 = thickness

z_size_2 = edge_length
x_2 = edge_length - thickness  # Positioned adjacent to the first plate
y_2 = 0
z_2 = 0

# Cutout dimensions and position on the first plate
cutout_size = 45  # mm
cutout_x = (edge_length - cutout_size) / 2  # Centered along x
y_cutout = (edge_length - cutout_size) / 2  # Centered along y
z_cutout = 0  # On the surface of the first plate

# Return the calculated values
{
    "x_size_1": x_size_1, "y_size_1": y_size_1, "z_size_1": z_size_1, "x_1": x_1, "y_1": y_1, "z_1": z_1,
    "x_size_2": x_size_2, "y_size_2": y_size_2, "z_size_2": z_size_2, "x_2": x_2, "y_2": y_2, "z_2": z_2,
    "cutout_size": cutout_size, "cutout_x": cutout_x, "y_cutout": y_cutout, "z_cutout": z_cutout
}"}
